text: Hello! Ready for today? It's Friday, November 20. Time for the weather! Friday at last. One more day and it's the weekend. In Shanghai today, expect it to be wall to wall sunshine. It will reach 10 degrees, and drop down to 4 degrees. It will feel quite nippy, especially first thing. You probably won't need a raincoat today. Here's something to notice: today is about 2 degrees cooler than yesterday. Will you need an extra layer? Wrap up warm today, with a big coat and cosy gloves! As for tomorrow, expect it to be glorious and sunny, with a high of 13 degrees. Remember, our theme this week is taking turns. What have you noticed today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
